news.headline: Meta Slashes 8,000 Jobs in Major AI Restructure
news.summary: Meta has launched the first wave of a 10% workforce reduction, cutting roughly 8,000 roles while reassigning 7,000 employees to AI-focused teams. The move is tied to record AI infrastructure spending.

news.headline: Nvidia Smashes Records With $81.6B Revenue, AI Boom Roars On
news.summary: Nvidia reported record Q1 FY2027 revenue of $81.6 billion — up 85% year-over-year — driven by insatiable demand for AI chips. Data center revenue alone hit $75.2B, and Q2 guidance came in at $91 billion.

educational.title: What Is an ETF? The Easiest Way to Own the Market
points: An ETF (Exchange-Traded Fund) holds a basket of stocks you can buy like a single share.
One S&P 500 ETF gives you instant exposure to 500 top U.S. companies at once.
ETFs have ultra-low fees — often under 0.1% per year vs. 1%+ for mutual funds.
They trade on exchanges all day, giving you flexibility that mutual funds don't offer.
Beginners love ETFs: low cost, instant diversification, and no stock-picking needed.
